note: These are candidate-only pilot lanes derived from public-source signals. They are not verified public problems and must not be presented as partner endorsements.

cases.objective: Test whether a reviewed Problem Packet improves neutral problem understanding and contribution entry relative to a conventional/raw project-wish brief.
cases.control_arm: raw public wish/project brief with equivalent source facts and no Problem Commons enrichment
cases.treatment_arm: redacted reviewed Problem Packet with uncertainty, frontier, constraints, success/falsification, and decomposition
required_external_reviews: problem owner or original wish author when permission is available
stop_conditions: source terms do not permit the planned comparison
the raw brief cannot be used without implying endorsement

cases.objective: Determine whether current Taoyuan open data supports a defensible non-causal corridor-investigation problem before any pedestrian intervention is prescribed.
cases.treatment_arm: Problem Packet that explicitly separates corridor discovery, exposure/measurement, mechanism discrimination, design, and authority
required_external_reviews: local problem owner or competent municipal/operator counterpart before any intervention stage
primary_measures: whether a credible measurement contribution emerges
stop_conditions: datasets cannot be joined at defensible granularity
no credible exposure/denominator can be established
field observation contradicts the corridor formulation
no competent owner can validate the operational problem

cases.objective: Test whether a useful public Problem Packet and solver review process can exist while underlying application-gated data remain restricted and separately authorized.
cases.control_arm: task description that assumes direct dataset access
cases.treatment_arm: minimum-necessary public Problem Packet plus separately granted restricted-data access when required
required_external_reviews: data/rightsholder or program-rule review before any real restricted dataset use
solver with public-only pack before restricted access
primary_measures: time to identify whether restricted access is actually needed
stop_conditions: data terms or program rules prohibit the proposed pilot
public pack leaks restricted locators or sensitive metadata
the task can only be formulated by inventing a problem from dataset availability
